cross_references.relationship: §1826 is the pre-appointment investigation; §1851 is the ongoing periodic review. Same court investigator function, same independence requirement, same duty to determine conservatee's wishes. §1851 is §1826 recurring.

§1851(a)(A) requires the investigator to ask whether the conservatee wishes to terminate; the conservatee's answer is the trigger for §1860 termination proceedings. §1851 is the discovery mechanism for the §1860 termination right.

§1851 requires conservator to make all books, records, and financial accounts available to the investigator. §2620 requires annual accountings to the court. The two provisions create overlapping financial oversight — the §2620 accounting is the conservator's self-report; the §1851 review is the independent check.
